name: Kanishk Sasikumar
introduction: High school senior / Technology, business & entrepreneurship
about: I'm a high school senior interested in technology, business, and entrepreneurship, and in filling the gaps from education to health care. From building iOS apps and AI hackathon projects to competing at DECA internationals and advising on multi-agent AI systems, I'm constantly exploring how computer science can solve real-world problems. Currently a Technical Advisor at HTA, VP of Competition in DECA, and a peer tutor to 22+ students across 7 countries.
